about: F0 inventory of code in framework/ and agents/ that enumerates the reference sites; enforced by framework/tests/test_no_two_site_enumerations.py (see its docstring for what counts as a hit).

This is W1's work list (switch consumers to site_registry after the BFCM freeze): each entry's w1 note says what replaces it. Fix an entry, delete it; the test fails on stale entries so the list stays exact and ends at zero.
Entries match on (path, scope, kind, size, tokens) and count. line and snippet are informational: line numbers drift.

reference_sites holds the site ids the scan looks for: the two live sites plus runtimepicks, the site being built, so new code cannot pair it with a live site either. If the niche changes, replace runtimepicks with the new site's id.

not_detected lists W1-relevant places this scan cannot flag: they name a single site (a default), no literal at all, or sit outside the scan roots (install/ and scripts/ are not scanned). They are informational and not enforced; W1 should change each together with the matching entry.
